title: W5' fix (rail plate swallows presses in effect_ui_press) ships with zero test coverage
detail: The claimed fix for r2 W5' is a new app-layer branch exercised by no test; deleting the guard stays green. Same class as r1 B1, which shipped broken precisely on an unpinned app-layer wiring path. noc_panel_hit/rect are pinned, the swallow decision is not.
recommended_fix: Add a noc_toggle_test-style leg: build App, set overlay_on, call effect_ui_press with a pos inside noc_panel_rect (expect true) and outside (expect fall-through).

title: W1' fix (demolish popover clamps to play_w) has no test — no test file references popover at all
evidence:
if x + w > f32(v.play_w) { x = anchor.x - w - hud_f(v, 18) }
...
x = min(x, f32(v.play_w) - w - hud_f(v, 8))
 — grep -rn "popover" app harness --include=*_test.odin -il returns no files; both changed clamp lines are unpinned.
detail: The claimed fix for r2 W1' (invisible-but-clickable demolish button under the plate) is untested: reverting play_w to win_w passes every suite. popover_rect is pure (^View, anchor, h -> Rectangle) — directly pinnable like settings_panel_rect_follows_the_playfield.
recommended_fix: Pin popover_rect with rail off (win_w clamp, byte-identical) and rail on via view_set_rail (east-edge anchor flips/clamps left of play_w), mirroring the settings-panel test.

title: B1' fix pin is alignment-insensitive — reverting headers to left-aligned draw_mono_c (the r2 blocker) stays green
evidence:
hdr4 := f32(font_glyph_advance(mono, 'd')) * NOC_SIZE_LABEL / FONT_BASE_SIZE * 4 // a 4-char header ("drop"/"loss")
	testing.expect(t, f32(84) >= hdr4, "the 15px headers fit the 84px pitch when right-aligned")
	rate_r := noc_panel_x(1280) + NOC_PANEL_W - 6
	testing.expect(t, rate_r <= 1280 - 6, "the /3s header anchor ends inside the window (never clipped)")
detail: Both assertions are true under the r2 defect: hdr4 measures a width and rate_r asserts the anchor, not the text end (left-aligned '/3s' at 1262 ends ~1289). Production draws headers via noc_col (noc_overlay.odin:700-704) but nothing asserts right-alignment; detection rests on the per-PR KYLE grade, not a durable test.
recommended_fix: Extract the per-class header anchors into a pure helper shared by header and data rows so the pin asserts one right-aligned source; or compute header text-end (anchor + width) against the window edge.

title: W4' residual: zoom/pan/pullback call sites pass play_w but are exercised only at play_w == win_w
evidence:
cx, cy := rnd.camera_anchor_center(wx, wy, pos.x, pos.y, f32(v.play_w), f32(v.win_h), fit, z_to)
	cx, cy = rnd.camera_clamp_center(cx, cy, f32(v.play_w), f32(v.win_h), fit, z_to, v.world_w, v.world_h)
 — grep -n "view_set_rail" app/pullback_test.odin returns exactly one hit (line 223, inside the new camera_update test); the camera_zoom_at/effect_pan/pullback_feed tests never set the rail.
detail: The r2 W4' ask was 'camera_update leg + a zoom clamp assert'; only the camera_update leg landed. The pure helpers are width-parametric and pinned, so risk is low, but the three re-anchored call sites have no rail-on coverage.
recommended_fix: Add one rail-on leg through camera_zoom_at (clamp keeps the world's east edge at play_w) reusing the existing pullback_test fixture.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100% (drift/stream-neutrality/D-gate: camera_fit_respects_the_rail, noc_toggle legs, 48/48 + .t1 sidecar evidence). P1 ~80-85%: W2'/W3'/camera_update leg FULL, ladder/width/rows/caps/rect/wheel-policy/banner/modal FULL; but W1' popover and W5' press-swallow fixes NONE, B1' header mechanism PARTIAL, zoom/pan/pullback rail-on PARTIAL. Overall >=80%.
recommended_fix: Pin the W1' popover clamp and W5' press-swallow branches plus one rail-on zoom-clamp leg (the three findings above) to lift P1 >=90% -> PASS.
